title: Monoco - Location, Weakness & How to Beat
description: Monoco in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - location, elemental weakness and how to beat it.

facts.label: Joins
facts.value: Late Act 2 - after being fought as a story boss

sections.title: Who They Are
sections.content:
Monoco is the most flexible party member and the least specialised. He is fought as a story boss alongside Stalact before he can be recruited, and his value is AP generation for the whole party rather than personal damage.

Joins: Late Act 2 - after being fought as a story boss

sections.title: Background
sections.content:
Contains story spoilers - stop here if you have not finished the game.

Monoco is a Gestral. The Gestrals were created by the painted Verso, and Monoco specifically was modelled on his real-world dog.

sections.title: Playable or NPC
sections.content:
Their defining mechanic is Bestial Wheel (Transform).

Party role: Flex / AP Support.

In the party tier list they sit at B.
